title: Individualized Dosing Schedule of Inhaled Bronchodilator for Endotracheally Intubated COPD Patients
brief_summary: This study evaluates whether individualized dosing schedule of inhaled bronchodilator is more effective than fixed dosing in reducing airway resistance of intubated COPD patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
* acute respiratory failure under ventilator support for less than 72 hours
* endotracheal tube inserted

Exclusion Criteria:

* confirmed asthma
* Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation II score over 35
* a co-morbidity of septic shock
